summary: Iteration 2 testing of KHALABA — patient timeline, appointments CRUD + status updates, and FR/EN/AR i18n with RTL. Created 10 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_features.py (all PASS). All 31 backend tests pass (10 new + 21 regression). Frontend: patient dashboard renders the 3 new sections, language toggle works for FR/EN/AR with RTL applied to <html dir='rtl'> and sidebar flipped to the right, persists in localStorage. Soignant agenda renders shadcn Calendar + opens 'Nouveau rendez-vous' dialog with all expected data-testids; submitting creates a new appointment (agenda counter 3 -> 4) and a success toast appears. Patient agenda groups Passés appointments with translated status badges. Patient Baby page renders empty state. Admin dashboard regression OK (3 Recharts SVGs).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='patient-cpn-list' and data-testid='patient-postnatal-list' are NOT present on the rendered DOM. The two sections render correctly visually ('Historique de mes consultations prénatales' and 'Mes visites postnatales'), but the parent <section>/<div> for each is missing its data-testid. Only data-testid='patient-dashboard' is present.

data-testid='day-appts-list' is NOT present on the right-side day-detail container. Could not verify mark-done-{id} / mark-missed-{id} buttons because no appointments fell on the currently-selected day (today=2026-06-22) and the calendar previous-month chevron lacks a stable selector (no aria-label, no data-testid).

Previous/next month chevrons in the shadcn Calendar caption have no aria-label or data-testid — automated tests cannot reliably navigate months. Add aria-label='Previous month'/'Next month' or data-testid='calendar-prev'/'calendar-next'.

action_items: Add data-testid='patient-cpn-list' to the 'Historique de mes consultations prénatales' container and data-testid='patient-postnatal-list' to the 'Mes visites postnatales' container in /app/frontend/src/pages/patient/PatientDashboard.jsx.

Add data-testid='day-appts-list' to the day-detail right panel in /app/frontend/src/pages/soignant/SoignantAgenda.jsx, and ensure mark-done-{id}/mark-missed-{id} buttons are rendered when appointments exist for the selected day (verified via backend that they do exist on 2026-02-15 / 2026-03-20 / 2026-04-10).
Add aria-label or data-testid to the shadcn Calendar previous/next month buttons so e2e tests can navigate months.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/appointments/{appt_id} accepts a free-form dict instead of a Pydantic model — replace with a Pydantic AppointmentPatchIn (Literal[scheduled, done, missed] for status) to get 422 instead of 400 for invalid statuses.

GET /api/patient/me/timeline ignores zone scoping — fine for a patient (they only see their own data), but the endpoint should still attach an explicit projection to avoid leaking any future PII fields.

Appointment 'type' Literal enum is 'CPN' (upper) but the patient agenda displays it lowercase ('vaccination'); ensure the soignant SELECT options and the patient list display are aligned with the i18n keys.
server.py is still ~660 lines (was 627). Strongly recommend splitting into routers/{auth,patients,pregnancies,appointments,analytics}.py before iteration 3.
CORS still has allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True — browsers reject Set-Cookie cross-origin in that combo. For production, set an explicit allow_origins list.
